Silent accounts that haven't created a first project by day 6 rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though Pro plan purchase suggests some intent.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting your first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Just checking in since your Wrenfield welcome note last week. If it's helpful, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is usually the easiest place to start — and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything about how your team is structured.

Best,
Priya
